author_ruling: PAPER_C_DESIGN.md AUTHOR RULING 2026-08-25 -- declared circularity is admitted for a RELATIVE measurement (the translation cost). Absolute rows are printed and labelled 'under a declared-circular answer model' and are never headlined.

arm_definitions.L: top-4 concepts by cos(d_c, R_s) in tower space, ties by concept id (no text)
arm_definitions.T: SBERT top-4 (mincos 0.30) of adapter A's banked concept-hot render of the m=5 blend target
arm_definitions.Tprime: the same, from the scrambled twin A' (correspondence-destroying control)
arm_definitions.P: the same, from the channel-matched prior-only text (zeroed latent + concept hot)

answer_model.rule: answer(r, c) = sign(u*_r . d_c), +-1, refusal never simulated
answer_model.u_star: fold_items_frozen(ctx.enc, ctx.allb[r]) -- the env's own full fold-in profile latent, identical in construction to answer_contrast.u_star
answer_model.note: the certified fold's cap_negatives over the REVEALED set still applies, so a user answering k of the 4 concepts negatively folds them at -min(1, c_neg/k) rather than -1. It is the env's own certified operator and it is applied identically in all four arms.

declared_choices.base_is_m0_no_fold: the arms are scored against the m=0 (no-fold) intercept on the state's own cohort; the state's interview PREFIX is not folded in any arm (the sheet's base row). Arm-symmetric.
declared_choices.ask_order: ascending concept id within an arm, so two arms selecting the SAME set fold identically. Arm-symmetric.
declared_choices.prior_text_arm: P uses adapter A's concept-hot prior-only text, the channel-matched one, identical for all 42 states

measure: each arm's concepts asked as questions, answered by the declared-circular sign rule at +-1, folded by the env's certified ConceptFoldNet(cv3) path and scored full + tail NDCG@10 by genv_eval -- policy-B pool, learned decoder bias, mask contract live. No second scorer exists in this file.

bootstrap.per_state: paired percentile over the state's own user-rows
bootstrap.summary: stratified: users resampled WITHIN state, states fixed, weight = cohort size (the pooled user-row mean)
bootstrap.nesting_caveat: the 42 states are nested, so a user can appear in several; the summary treats states as independent strata and therefore UNDERSTATES its interval. The per-state rows are the primary object.

reference.definition: R_s = sum_j w_j * tower(q_j) over the state's banked m=5 ingredients (c4_pilot.reference_directions, IMPORTED)

disclosure.note: Ew rows carry their own magnitude, d_c rows are unit -- so in a mixed blend the nominal weight is not the effective one. Reported, not corrected: R_s is defined by the sheet in exactly these two objects.

what_may_not_be_claimed: no absolute 'asking it helps' claim (the ruling's fatal use stays closed); nothing about the item channel; nothing from emission renders (retracted); no generalisation beyond the 42 nested, structurally-selected states -- the C1 population caveats travel
